Full mod menu for **Minecraft PE v1.26.52** on iOS 17 Dopamine rootless.

Floating MC button with Player, Movement, Combat, World and ESP sections.

Works out of the box: Night Vision, Zoom, FPS counter, Coords overlay, ESP overlay. Memory cheats (GodMode, Fly, Speed, KillAura) activate via MCPEOffsets.plist once offsets are mapped.
